name: Sigil — a quartered seal on the round

recipe.name: Delft clay starting recipe / Gold 18k
recipe.calibration_note: Uncalibrated starting allowance. Confirm with the caster's alloy, pattern material, mold, and measured trials.

manufacturing.bench_notes: Pour factory stock 013 bare from the drafted sand master, parting at z = 0. At the bench, cut the seal into the table: the two sunk quarters (first and fourth) and the sunk bordure, each to its flat floor; break the cut edges and polish the raised quarters and the rim.

component.bench_notes: Cut at the bench after the pour, its top edge broken and its floor and walls left satin; the pattern is the bare stock.
